answer: Stop counting heads: decide by futarchy. Each proposal opens two conditional markets forecasting the economy's welfare metric if it passes or fails; the higher price wins and trades in the losing branch are refunded. At that decision vertex a thousand sybil keys weigh no more than one wallet with the same coin, and an attacker who pushes a price the wrong way just pays honest arbitrageurs, whose correcting tide drains him. Fake names become a frozen tundra with no influence to harvest.
